definitions.full: H618. asam [ אָסָם ] noun masculine Prov 3:10 storehouse (Aramaic אסנא , id. , store, supply ) plural suffix אֲסָמֶיךָ Deut 28:8 ; Prov 3:10 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to heap together;
